approval_requests.description: Canonical current state of a human-owned Approval Request, from draft through a terminal decision or cancellation.
approval_requests.lifecycle: Created in DRAFT; retained through terminal state. No automatic deletion or legal retention duration is defined; production retention remains a separate decision.

id.description: Backend-generated immutable UUID that is both the primary key and public resource identifier.

creator_id.description: Immutable provider-independent Orion principal UUID of the human who owns the request; supplied by the trusted authentication boundary.

title.description: Owner-authored concise purpose of the approval request; editable only in DRAFT.

description.description: Optional owner-authored supporting context; editable only in DRAFT.

status.description: Current lifecycle state; APPROVED, REJECTED, and CANCELLED are terminal.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token, initialized to one and incremented exactly once per successful edit or transition.

rejection_reason.description: Reviewer-authored reason for rejection, present exactly when status is REJECTED.
rejection_reason.nullMeaning: The request has not been rejected.

idempotency_key.description: Opaque caller-supplied creation intent key, unique within creator_id and retained with the request.

intent_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical title and description creation intent; detects key reuse for different content.

created_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock absolute creation instant, serialized as UTC RFC 3339; does not constitute audit history.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock absolute instant of the latest successful write; not a concurrency token or audit history.

objects.approval_requests_pkey: Enforces the immutable unique request identity used by persistence and the public API.
objects.approval_requests_creator_key_unique: Prevents two requests for one owner and creation intent key, including racing inserts.
objects.approval_requests_mine_page_idx: Supports authorized owner pagination by creation time and ID.
objects.approval_requests_review_page_idx: Supports submitted reviewable pagination before applying the non-owner predicate.
objects.approval_requests_title_nonblank: Rejects blank titles even if a caller bypasses the API.
objects.approval_requests_description_nonblank: Optional description cannot be whitespace only.
objects.approval_requests_rejection_reason_state: Requires one nonblank reason exactly for a rejected request.
objects.approval_requests_idempotency_key_nonbla: Creation keys must use the documented opaque ASCII key alphabet and cannot be blank.
objects.approval_requests_fingerprint_sha256: Fingerprint is exactly lowercase SHA-256 hex.

enums.ApprovalRequestStatus: Five-state request lifecycle: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED.
